purpose: functional verification of changing a sandbox's size on KVM; the times are the check's own stopwatch and not a benchmark

cases.name: resize reboots a running sandbox at its new size, keeping its variables, not its memory
a sandbox's disk is kept across a resize
asking for the size it has changes nothing, and keeps its memory
back at its template's size it is restored, and pauses and resumes with its memory
resume at another size boots it at that size; resumed again, it keeps it
its usage counts each size for the time it ran at it
what cannot be done is refused, each with why

refused.no size: give cpuCount, memoryMB or both: the size to reboot it at
refused.no processors: cpuCount 0: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
refused.more processors than the host: cpuCount 4096: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
refused.too little memory: memoryMB 128: an even number from 256 to 65536
refused.an odd amount: memoryMB 1023: an even number from 256 to 65536
refused.a paused sandbox: sandbox sbx-09be59e863664d0096f8 is paused: resume it with cpuCount and memoryMB to bring it back at another size
refused.resuming at a size that cannot be: memoryMB 100: an even number from 256 to 65536
